book.name: 2 TESALONAIKA
book.title: ME TESALONAIKA ꞌIDI LETA ꞌELUWENA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: ꞌAboꞌama Sailasa be Timoti maꞌegwao ꞌimi leta ꞌaꞌetoꞌetoladinawa ꞌomi toekalesiyao Tesalonaika ꞌenaya, manuna ꞌomi Tamada Yaubada be ꞌInapwana Yesu Keliso ꞌadi toemisao.
Tamada Yaubada be ꞌida ꞌInapwana Yesu Keliso ꞌidi obobomega wada miya gwausowala.
Keliso maꞌetamo ꞌiilama tomota ꞌadi loina manuna
Gosemao, ꞌilobwenema be tuta yauyauna Yaubada ꞌada lokagutokiye ꞌimi emisa be ꞌimi eobooboboma taumimo ꞌemiya ꞌadi sinabwa manuna.

ꞌEnega toekalesiyao sena yaudi matadiya ꞌatuputupumi, ꞌagwae, “Taudi me Tesalonaika eꞌalamaꞌiꞌita ꞌaledi. ꞌAnabwaꞌayoi ꞌadi talauwalao mwau sinabwana siꞌebwaꞌedi, ta tuwa tuga ma idi ꞌalamaꞌiꞌita be ma idi emisa Yaubada ꞌenaya.”
Gete ꞌebeꞌita be ꞌenega Yaubada ꞌina loina palupaluna tada mwalatoni, manuna ꞌimi miyamwau nidi ꞌediyega ꞌigiepaꞌalimi, be ꞌenega ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌana lugu ꞌida lobwenemi.
Nadigega wate saꞌi taudi ꞌami togieꞌelouyao ꞌadi eꞌisa Yaubada ꞌigibugibubu be ꞌina gamwasowala sida loba.
ꞌOmi tomiyamwau yaeonami ꞌaene maꞌetamo ꞌida ꞌInapwana Yesu galewega ꞌida mwaꞌuta maninima, ma ina aniloseyao ta ꞌawe sabelulu wate ꞌida meꞌe, be ꞌomi ta ꞌaboꞌama ꞌida ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata ꞌida ꞌebwaꞌeda,
ta taudi ꞌida ꞌInapwana Yesu Keliso tetelina siguitoyasena, ga Yaubada siemwagemwageyena, ꞌadi eꞌisa mwauna ꞌida ꞌebwaꞌedi.
ꞌEnega sida miya dumaduma, ta sida esilae ataya ꞌasa gabugabu ꞌenaya, be ꞌInapwana maninina be ꞌina waiwai ta ꞌana tupu geyaꞌabo siꞌitaꞌita.

Manuna ꞌabo tuta nina ꞌimamai, ꞌana tupu sinabwana ꞌida loba ꞌina guinuwao ꞌebe nuwaowana manudi ꞌana toemisao ꞌediyega. Ta ꞌomi lowa tetelina ꞌaꞌebwaꞌemi ga waemisena, ꞌenega maꞌetamo ꞌomi maꞌemao Yesu ꞌina apwesama ꞌenaya tada tupu.

Lowa Yaubada ꞌiesinuwemi ga ꞌibwauyemi, ga ꞌenega waemisena. Gete manuna ꞌaboꞌama tuta yauyauna ꞌasidasida manumi be ꞌaene wada muliya ꞌaiꞌaili. Manuna ꞌomi nuwanuwami be emisa ꞌaiꞌailega wada bubuna palupalu, ꞌenega ꞌima sidasida Yaubada ꞌenaya ꞌaene ꞌida giewaiwaiyemi be guinuwa nidi wada guinuwedi.

Gete ꞌenega be tomota yaudi ꞌida ꞌInapwana Yesu ꞌana esana situpu, ꞌomi ꞌimi guinuwa boboꞌadi manudi. Ta ꞌomi wate tupu waloba tauna ꞌana esanega, ta tupu nidi maiboꞌana Yaubada be ꞌInapwana Yesu Keliso ꞌidi oboboma ꞌenega.
